niche.trendNote: Free outdoor fitness community — anti-commercial ethos. Identity is real but telecom is not their identity battleground. Small population. NICHE: potentially valuable as a community partnership for brand authenticity, but not a commercial target.

niche.name: Anti-GLP-1 Fitness Influencer
niche.compoundPotential: Moderate — influencer amplification potential
niche.trendNote: Anti-GLP-1 stance is a real identity signal within fitness communities but politically complex (opposes a medical treatment). niche.name: Crypto-Curious Mainstream Investor

NICHE: pathway persona — if Gather earns trust with P-009/P-010, curious mainstream investors will follow through community osmosis.
